name: owncloud-client
description: Dockerized ownCloud CLI Client (owncloudcmd) to sync from any supported ownCloud-like (e.g. TransIP STACK, NextCloud) enviroment.

paths.name: Sync Location
paths.description: The path where the files will be synced to

variables.name: OC_PASS
variables.description: Password or App-Token for the ownCloud user

variables.name: OC_SERVER
variables.description: ownCloud Server URL, with, if necessary, with port

variables.name: OC_URLPATH
variables.description: Server path to the ownCloud instance

variables.name: OC_FILEPATH
variables.description: Only sync one specific folder. Use '/' for everything

variables.name: RUN_UID
variables.description: UID for the occlient user and sync location

variables.name: RUN_GID
variables.description: GID for the occlient user and sync location

variables.name: OC_WEBDAV
variables.description: In case the webdav path is not default, you can change it here

variables.name: TRUST_SELFSIGN
variables.description: Set to 1 to trust self-signed certificates

variables.name: SYNC_HIDDEN
variables.description: Set to 1 to sync all hidden files within the specified ownCloud directory

variables.name: SILENCE_OUTPUT
variables.description: Set to 0 to get more verbose output

variables.name: RUN_INTERVAL
variables.description: Interval in seconds at which the client will run and check for changes
